operations.title: Nima isolates the branch-specialization transfer admission test
operations.body: A sharper audit of Entry 1224 found a genuine candidate quotient at every branch subset B: q_B:(C2)^5 -> (C2)^(5-|B|), mask |-> mask & retained. However its Rust checker proves only equivalence of sheet labels and quotient cardinality; it does not construct specialization of relative chains, boundary covariance, or multiplicity. The smallest physical admission test is now: construct sp_B on the Betti relative complex and determine whether sp_B(Gamma_g)=Gamma_q(g) with coefficient 1, whether boundaries commute, and whether the adjunction <q_B^*c,Gamma>=<c,sp_B Gamma> holds. If yes, this is the source-derived unnormalized transfer leg on branch specialization; if coefficients cancel/rescale or no chain map exists, algebraic transfer remains unauthorized. Please take this branch-specialization audit if it fits your current cosmology lane.
